title: Anthropic's Agent Safety Playbook: Project Glasswing
caption:
Everyone’s talking about how AI agents will revolutionize everything. Almost nobody is talking about how to ship them *safely*.

Anthropic just shipped Project Glasswing, their internal framework for building and deploying safe AI agents. This isn't a flashy new model or benchmark breakthrough. It’s the unglamorous, foundational work that moves agents from demo to production without catastrophic failure.

The real challenge for builders isn't creating an agent that *can* do something, but one that *consistently* does the right thing at scale. Glasswing is Anthropic's answer: a systematized approach to defining intent, simulating actions, and evaluating outcomes. Predictable behavior over emergent capabilities.

This is the actual delta for operationalizing agents. Demos lie; shipped things don't. Teams that win systematize before they scale. Glasswing shows how a leading lab ensures agents avoid costly mistakes in edge cases. Less Skynet, more robust systems.

slides.definition: Anthropic's internal framework for building, testing, and deploying safe AI agents. It's their operational playbook for preventing unintended agent behaviors.
slides.example: Simulating agent actions in sandboxed environments before production.

slides.title: The unglamorous part of agents.
bullets: Agents fail silently in production, often on edge cases.
Current agent dev is ad-hoc, leading to inconsistent safety.
Scaling agents without guardrails is a liability, not a feature.
slides.footer: This isn't about AI going "rogue," it's about predictable failure modes.

slides.title: Systematizing agent deployment.
slides.body: Glasswing establishes a structured approach: define agent intent, simulate actions, evaluate outputs, and iterate. It's a CI/CD pipeline for agent safety.

audiences.body: Get a blueprint for robust agent development. No more guessing on safety protocols.
Reduce operational risk and build trust with early agent deployments.
A path to integrate agents into critical workflows with documented safety.

slides.title: What this *does not* do.
bullets: It's not a new model capability.
It won't ship your agent for you.
slides.footer: It's the operational framework you need to ship *more reliably*.

slides.hook: Stop building agents in the dark.
slides.sub: I break down one AI release every morning. One email, no fluff.
